site.extent: Between Grattan St and Faraday St (southbound, east side)
site.area: Parkville, opposite Sidney Myer Asia Centre, City of Melbourne

analysis.detour: Southbound traffic detours via Faraday St, Cardigan St and Grattan St to Swanston St (per inset map and signs). Detour signs: 'Detour via Faraday St', 'Use Cardigan St', 'Detour Grattan St to Swanston St'.
plan_elements: Work zone identified: Swanston St east side, Grattan St to Faraday St, opposite Sidney Myer Asia Centre
Lane closure of about 84 m, with a 38 m work area starting 22 m north of Grattan St
Southbound closed at Faraday St with a detour via Faraday and Cardigan Sts
Water filled barriers run along the work area beside the bike lane
Two VMS boards at the Faraday St end and two traffic controllers (TC 1 and TC 2) hold pedestrians and cyclists while plant crosses the bike lane
Footpath stays open with 1.5 m clear; bike lane stays open to the left of the barriers
Tram works note: within 20 m of tracks, Yarra Trams approval needed, barriers 0.8 m clear of tram envelope
Northbound lane and trams unaffected; no right turn from Grattan St into Swanston St north

equipment.detail: VMS 1: 'Swanston St Sth closed at Faraday' / 'Detour via Faraday St'. VMS 2: 'Swanston St Sth closed' / 'Use Cardigan St'
Red line along the east side of the work area, length not stated
TC 1 and TC 2 at each end of the work area, hold pedestrians and cyclists while plant crosses the bike lane
Orange sign on the Faraday St side, near the northern approach
Near the southern end of the zone
'Southbound closed, detour' sign at the northern end of the zone
Detour to Faraday St, detour to Grattan St to Swanston St, and detour via Faraday St signs
'Bike lane open, keep left of barriers'
Orange dots at the taper; spacing table given but count not readable

pedestrian_management: Footpath stays open with 1.5 m clear width
Pedestrian route shown in cyan along the east footpath past the work area
TC 1 and TC 2 hold pedestrians while plant crosses the bike lane
